entities.summary: AnnaLinden Weller, better known under the pen name Arkady Martine, is an American author of science fiction literature. Her first novels, A Memory Called Empire (2019) and A Desolation Called Peace (2021), each of which won the Hugo Award for Best Novel, form the Teixcalaan series.
